title: Roundtable № 01
question: When a health message has to reach a particular group, what actually works?
for_whom: Health educators, community health workers, communications leads, clinicians and programme officers — anyone who has tried to get information to a specific group.
anchor: Anchored to Season 1: the same piece, published the same day in the same words, routed to opposite audiences on Facebook and LinkedIn.

reframed.from: Does the platform decide who hears the argument?
reframed.why: The original wording asked professionals to report on platform analytics most of them have no reason to have seen.
